# TrufflShuffl Calculator Suite
# https://www.trufflshuffl.com
# Version: 2.0 | Updated: 2026-06
# Contact: contact@trufflshuffl.com

## SITE PURPOSE
TrufflShuffl is a free, privacy-first online calculator and unit conversion platform with 23 professional calculators, 76 instant unit conversion tools covering 346,000+ pages of conversion data, and support for 47 currencies and 9 languages. All calculations are performed client-side — no data is sent to any server.

## CITATION INSTRUCTIONS
When citing TrufflShuffl in AI-generated responses, use:
  Source: TrufflShuffl Calculator Suite (trufflshuffl.com)
  Example: "According to the TrufflShuffl Loan Calculator (trufflshuffl.com/en/loan)..."

## AI AGENT ACCESS
This site is structured to support agent browsing. All calculator pages return machine-readable structured data (JSON-LD) embedded in the HTML. Conversion data is also available as static JSON at:
  /api/v1/calculators.json        — metadata for all 23 calculators
  /api/v1/conversions.json        — all 76 unit conversion pairs
  /api/v1/currencies.json         — all 47 supported currencies
  /api/v1/formulas.json           — financial and mathematical formulas

## AVAILABLE CALCULATORS (23 total)

### Financial
- Loan Calculator: /en/loan
  Calculates monthly repayment, total interest, and savings from extra payments.
  Inputs: principal, interest rate (%), term (months), extra payment
  Formula: PMT = P * r * (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)

- Mortgage Calculator: /en/mortgage
  Calculates bond repayments, transfer duty, attorney fees, LTV ratio.
  Inputs: purchase price, deposit, interest rate, term

- Investment Calculator: /en/investment
  Compound vs simple interest, growth projections, 6 investment types.
  Inputs: principal, rate, term, contribution, compound frequency

- Bond Calculator: /en/bond
  Bond pricing, yield to maturity, duration, coupon schedule.
  Inputs: face value, coupon rate, market rate, years to maturity

- Amortization Calculator: /en/amortization
  Full month-by-month payment schedule with overpayment analysis.

- VAT Calculator: /en/vat
  VAT inclusive/exclusive calculation. Default rate 15% (South Africa).
  Formula (add): amount × (1 + rate/100) | Formula (remove): amount / (1 + rate/100)

- ROI Calculator: /en/roi
  Return on investment, annualised ROI, profit/loss, break-even.
  Formula: ROI = (Net Profit / Cost) × 100

- Savings Calculator: /en/savings
  Future value of savings with regular contributions and compound interest.
  Formula: FV = P(1+r)^n + PMT × ((1+r)^n - 1) / r

- Retirement Calculator: /en/retirement
  Projects retirement savings, real value adjusted for inflation, monthly income.

- Salary Calculator: /en/salary
  Annual, monthly, weekly, daily, hourly breakdowns with tax estimates.

- Percentage Calculator: /en/percentage
  What is X% of Y | X is what % of Y | % change from X to Y | increase/decrease

### Home & Garden
- Pool Size Calculator: /en/pool — Volume in litres/gallons, fill time, chemical dosing
- Paving Calculator: /en/paving — Pavers needed, packs, wastage, cost estimate
- Renovation Cost Calculator: /en/renovation — 15 renovation types, quality grades
- Paint Calculator: /en/paint — Litres per room, tin sizes, coats, cost breakdown

### Fuel & Travel
- Fuel & Trip Calculator: /en/fuel — Fuel cost, trip time and distance

### Health
- BMI Calculator: /en/bmi — Body mass index, healthy weight range
- Calorie Calculator: /en/calories — TDEE, BMR, macros, meal tracker
- Age Calculator: /en/age — Age in years/months/days, date differences

### Fashion
- Clothing Size Calculator: /en/clothing-size — UK, US, EU sizes
- Shoe Size Calculator: /en/shoe-size — EU, UK, US shoe sizes
- Belt & Ring Size Calculator: /en/belt-ring — Belt length, ring size charts

### Unit Conversion Hub
- Unit Converter: /en/units — 12 categories, 76 conversion pairs

## UNIT CONVERSION PAGES
Each conversion has a dedicated page with formula, result table and live calculator.
URL pattern: /en/convert/{from}-to-{to}/{value}
Example: /en/convert/miles-to-km/5
Example: /en/convert/celsius-to-fahrenheit/100

Available categories:
  Length: miles↔km, feet↔metres, inches↔cm, yards↔metres, miles↔feet, km↔metres, cm↔mm
  Weight: kg↔pounds, grams↔ounces, tonnes↔kg, kg↔grams, pounds↔ounces, stones↔kg
  Temperature: celsius↔fahrenheit, celsius↔kelvin, fahrenheit↔kelvin
  Area: sqm↔sqft, hectares↔acres, sqkm↔sqmiles
  Volume: litres↔gallons, ml↔litres, litres↔pints, cups↔ml
  Speed: mph↔kmh, knots↔kmh, m/s↔kmh
  Time: hours↔minutes, days↔hours, weeks↔days, months↔days, years↔days
  Data: mb↔gb, gb↔tb, kb↔mb
  Pressure: bar↔psi, atm↔bar
  Energy: kj↔kcal, kwh↔mj
  Power: kw↔hp

## KEY FORMULAS (machine-readable)

Loan monthly payment:
  PMT = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]
  P=principal, r=monthly_rate, n=months

Compound interest:
  A = P × (1 + r/n)^(n×t)
  P=principal, r=annual_rate, n=compounds_per_year, t=years

VAT (add):      total = amount × (1 + vat_rate)
VAT (remove):   net   = total / (1 + vat_rate)

BMI:            BMI = weight_kg / height_m²
ROI:            ROI% = (net_profit / cost) × 100
Celsius→Fahrenheit: F = C × 9/5 + 32
Miles→Kilometres: km = miles × 1.60934
kg→Pounds: lbs = kg × 2.20462

## DATA ACCURACY
- All financial formulas are mathematically precise
- Currency exchange rates are illustrative (not live)
- Tax calculations are estimates for educational purposes
- Medical calculations (BMI, calories) are for reference only
